nina.s: Follow-up from the authz postmortem. Short list of remediations and owners so we can close the loop. Root issues: token edge-case in parser, role binding drift, missing S2S audit events, and secrets not syncing to staging.

nina.s: Items: 1) Token parser hardening + tests -> @harold -> 48h. 2) Role binding ownership registry -> @infra-team -> 4d. 3) Audit ingest backfill + alert -> @sam.ops -> 36h. 4) Secrets sync reconciler + healthcheck -> @infra-team -> 72h.

harold: I'll take token parser. Plan: pin jwt-lib v3.4, add explicit int(exp) handling and unit + integration tests, then canary to staging.

sam.ops: For audit, I'll add an alert when audit.events.missing > 5/min and run a backfill dry-run first.

infra-team: We'll own the role registry and the secrets reconciler. Secrets reconciler will be rolling only and expose GET /reconciler/status.

nina.s: Please paste a 1-line accept with due epoch here so I can add reminders.

harold: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1972176000 (48h).

sam.ops: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1972098560 (36h).

infra-team: :thumbsup: We accept 
Due (role registry): 1972444800 (4d)
infra-team: :thumbsup: We accept 
Due (secrets): 1972380000 (72h).

nina.s: Security-bot: please schedule T-24h reminder for each owner.

sec-bot: Reminders scheduled: T-24h and T-4h for accepted items. Weekly digest for tag "authz" enabled. :robot_face:

harold: Note for PR: failing example was float `exp` -> comparisons did `==`. I'll include snippet: `exp_ts = int(float(payload["exp"]))`

sam.ops: I'll post dry-run counts before backfill.

infra-team: PR for reconciler runbook by EOD.

nina.s: Thanks. I'll update the remediation tracker and share a short retro with eng leads after items are closed. Reopen thread if any blocker.
